bundle-scroller.message.pick.nothing_fou: No item from the pick list was found in a bundle
bundle-scroller.message.pick.cant_put: %s can't be put into a bundle
bundle-scroller.config.generic.comment.b:
With a bundle on the cursor:
- Hold left-click and drag to put the items of every filled slot into the bundle. Release over an empty slot to put the bundle down there.
- Hold right-click and drag to put one item from the bundle into every empty slot.
bundle-scroller.config.generic.comment.a:
Requires Garitone Mineman.
When its easy eat or auto eat finds no food in the inventory, food is taken out of a bundle into a free slot and eaten.
Its autoEatBlacklist also applies to the food in bundles.
bundle-scroller.config.generic.comment.b:
Item Scroller's crafting (recipe clicks, scroll crafting, craft everything and mass craft) also uses items from bundles.
Missing ingredients are taken out of bundles into free inventory slots before Item Scroller fills the crafting grid.
bundle-scroller.config.generic.comment.a:
When the stack in your main hand runs out (placing blocks, eating, throwing, dropping), the same item is taken out of a bundle into your hand.
Works with any item, not only the ones on the pick list.
bundle-scroller.config.warning.mineman_m: Garitone Mineman is not installed, so this option does nothing.
bundle-scroller.config.hotkeys.comment.o: Open the Bundle Scroller config GUI
bundle-scroller.config.hotkeys.comment.p:
Empty main hand: take the next item of the pick list out of a bundle into your hand.
Item in the main hand: put it into a bundle.
Each press with an empty hand continues with the next item of the list.
